assessment: A strong response with verifiably correct cash math across every requested figure, a date-driven execution plan with sensible checkpoints and a parallel loan fallback, and solid risk framing around sunk cost and repayment ability. Judges broadly agreed on the math quality; recurring critiques were the missing clearance/price-anchoring risk analysis, optimism about later full-price sales of leftover stock, lack of a committed loan pre-approval, and no identified way to close the $2,000 residual gap under the liquidator path. A minor 'Jan 2, 2027' date year was flagged by one judge but not confirmed as a rule error.
judge_agreement: Four of five judges scored cash_math at 9, with deepseek at 8 and google the high outlier at 10. Execution_plan clustered at 8 (three judges) with openai lower at 7 and google higher at 10. Risk_awareness clustered tightly at 7 with qwen at 8 and google an extreme outlier at 10; all judges except google converged on the same weakness: unaddressed clearance/brand damage and over-optimistic assumptions about leftover inventory value.
